author: Leila Gharani
description:
Learn how to combine data from multiple sheets in Excel using the VSTACK function without ever copying and pasting. These 6 advanced VSTACK techniques will help you automate data consolidation and save hours of manual reporting time.

📥 Download the practice workbook here: https://www.xelplus.com/excel-vstack-function/#download

🎓 Get your whole team up to speed with our XelPlus courses (team licenses available): https://link.xelplus.com/yt-d-all-courses

In this tutorial, you will learn how to:
- Combine official Excel tables from different sheets into one clean list using VSTACK.
-Consolidate standard data ranges while planning for future data entries.
- Remove blank rows and zero values using the new dot annotation trick in Microsoft 365.
-Summarize and analyze your stacked data directly using the GROUPBY and CHOOSECOLS functions.
- Use 3D referencing with the FILTER function to consolidate monthly expense sheets.
- Set up dynamic 3D ranges using "Start" and "End" placeholder sheet
title: Stop Copying Data Between Excel Sheets! (Do This Instead)
